Fit Relative Length of Stay with a Gamma GLM (Log Link)

Source: R/daly_rr_and_los.R
daly_fit_los_rr.Rd

For each pathogen and antibiotic class, fits a Gamma generalised linear model with log link to the length of stay (LOS) of discharged admissions:

Usage

daly_fit_los_rr(
  data,
  admission_id_col = "PatientInformation_id",
  cluster_id_col = NULL,
  facility_col = "center_name",
  organism_col = "organism_name",
  syndrome_col = "syndrome",
  infection_type_col = "infection_type",
  antibiotic_class_col = "antibiotic_class",
  antibiotic_name_col = "antibiotic_name",
  antibiotic_value_col = "antibiotic_value",
  date_admission_col = "date_of_admission",
  date_discharge_col = "final_outcome_date",
  date_culture_col = "date_of_first_positive_culture",
  final_outcome_col = "final_outcome",
  final_outcome_value = "Discharged",
  age_col = "Age",
  sex_col = "Gender",
  unit_type_col = NULL,
  comorbidity_col = NULL,
  syndrome_name = NULL,
  organism_name = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  hospital_effect = c("fixed", "none", "stratified"),
  reference_hospital = NULL,
  intermediate_as_resistant = TRUE,
  hai_value = "HAI",
  cai_value = "CAI",
  icu_values = c("ICU", "Intensive Care", "Critical Care", "PICU", "NICU"),
  max_los = 365,
  min_n = 20L,
  min_resistant = 5L,
  min_susceptible = 5L,
  flag_min = 10L,
  ci_method = c("bootstrap", "delta", "none"),
  n_boot = 1000L,
  conf_level = 0.95,
  seed = NULL,
  return_draws = FALSE,
  patient_id_col = NULL,
  hai_threshold_hours = NULL
)

Arguments

data

Data frame with one row per antibiotic test result.

admission_id_col

Character. Admission identifier; the unit of analysis. Default "PatientInformation_id".

cluster_id_col

Character or NULL. Identifier used to cluster repeated admissions of the same patient in the bootstrap and the sandwich covariance. NULL clusters by admission.

facility_col

Character or NULL. Hospital column. NULL pools everything and forces hospital_effect = "none".

organism_col

Character. Pathogen column.

syndrome_col

Character. Syndrome column (used with syndrome_name).

infection_type_col

Character. Column holding the final HAI/CAI classification. Default "infection_type".

antibiotic_class_col, antibiotic_name_col, antibiotic_value_col

Character. Antibiotic class, drug name and S/I/R result columns.

date_admission_col, date_discharge_col

Character. Admission and final outcome date columns.

date_culture_col

Character. Culture date column, used to take covariates from each admission's earliest culture of the pathogen. When absent, the first row is used.

final_outcome_col, final_outcome_value

Character. Final outcome column and the value marking discharged admissions.

age_col, sex_col

Character or NULL. Age and sex columns; NULL leaves the covariate out.

unit_type_col

Character or NULL. Ward / ICU column.

comorbidity_col

Character or NULL. Comorbidity column.

syndrome_name

Character or NULL. Restrict to one syndrome.

organism_name

Character vector or NULL. Pathogens to model; NULL models all.

classes

NULL (all classes), a character vector (the same classes for every pathogen), or a named list of character vectors (a panel per pathogen, names matching organism_name values).

hospital_effect

One of "fixed", "none", "stratified". See "Hospital effect".

reference_hospital

Character or NULL. Reference level of the hospital fixed effect; NULL uses the hospital with most admissions in each model. Does not change any estimate.

intermediate_as_resistant

Logical. See "Resistance".

hai_value, cai_value

Character. Values of infection_type_col for HAI and CAI; other values are treated as missing.

icu_values

Character vector. Values of unit_type_col counted as ICU (matched case-insensitively as substrings).

max_los

Numeric. Maximum LOS in days. Default 365.

min_n, min_resistant, min_susceptible

Integer. Minimum admissions, resistant admissions and susceptible admissions for a model to be fitted.

flag_min

Integer. Hospitals with fewer resistant or susceptible admissions than this are flagged low_support in the hospital table (they are still estimated).

ci_method

One of "bootstrap", "delta", "none".

n_boot

Integer. Bootstrap replicates. Default 1000.

conf_level

Numeric. Confidence level. Default 0.95.

seed

Integer or NULL. Random seed for the bootstrap.

return_draws

Logical. Return the bootstrap replicates.

patient_id_col

Deprecated. Use admission_id_col.

hai_threshold_hours

Deprecated and ignored. HAI/CAI is read from infection_type_col.

Value

A list with:

rr

One row per pathogen x class (x hospital for "stratified"): RR_LOS with CI_lower, CI_upper, beta_log_rr, se_log_rr_cluster; counts; observed mean LOS of R and S admissions; all-hospital LOSR, LOSS and excess_LOS with intervals; dispersion; RxHospital_p; covariates used and settings.

hospital

One row per pathogen x class x hospital: counts, observed and predicted mean LOS of R and S admissions (a calibration check), LOSR, LOSS, excess_LOS with intervals, RR_LOS, low_support and fallback_all_admissions.

draws

When return_draws = TRUE and ci_method = "bootstrap": a list named "pathogen | class" ("pathogen | class | hospital" for "stratified"), each with RR_LOS (vector), LOSR, LOSS (replicate x hospital matrices, days) and LOSR_all, LOSS_all (all-hospital values, vectors). Pass it to daly_calc_yld_associated() / daly_calc_yld_attributable() as los_draws.

skipped

Pathogen x class (x hospital) combinations not fitted, with the reason.

Details

$$\log E(LOS_i) = \beta_0 + \beta_R R_i + \beta_1 HAI_i + \beta_2 Age_i + \beta_3 Sex_i + \beta_4 ICU_i + \beta_5 Comorbidity_i + \gamma_{h(i)}$$

and returns the relative LOS, \(RR_{LOS} = \exp(\beta_R)\), together with the adjusted LOS of resistant admissions (LOSR) and of the same admissions had they been susceptible (LOSS), per hospital and for all hospitals combined.

Unit of analysis

One row per admission x pathogen x antibiotic class. LOS is computed once per admission by daly_compute_patient_los() (final outcome date minus admission date, discharged admissions only, 0 < LOS <= max_los). An admission with several pathogens enters each pathogen's models.

Resistance (worst phenotype)

For an admission and pathogen, a class is resistant (R = 1) when any result of that pathogen for any drug in the class is R, and susceptible (R = 0) when it was tested and no result is R. Results of other pathogens in the same admission are not used. With intermediate_as_resistant = TRUE, I counts as R except for colistin, where I counts as S (the convention of prep_recode_intermediate_ast()); with FALSE, I results are dropped. Admissions not tested for a class are excluded from that class's model.

Covariates

Taken from each admission's earliest culture of the pathogen (date_culture_col): HAI (1 if infection_type_col equals hai_value, 0 if it equals cai_value, otherwise missing), age (linear), sex, ICU (when unit_type_col is given) and comorbidity (when comorbidity_col is given). Admissions with a missing value in a requested covariate are dropped from that model and counted in n_dropped_covariates. A covariate with no variation in a model is left out of that model.

Hospital effect

"fixed" (default)

One model per pathogen x class across all hospitals, with hospital as a fixed effect. Each hospital has its own LOS level; the resistance effect (RR_LOS) is shared. Small hospitals are kept and borrow the resistance effect.

"none"

One model with no hospital term.

"stratified"

A separate model in each hospital, so each hospital has its own RR_LOS. Hospitals below the minimum counts are skipped.

For "fixed", RxHospital_p is the F-test p-value for adding a resistance x hospital interaction, i.e. evidence that the resistance effect differs between hospitals.

LOSR and LOSS

Model predictions are averaged over a hospital's own resistant admissions: LOSR with R = 1 and LOSS with R = 0 for the same admissions. LOSS is therefore the counterfactual LOS of the resistant admissions had they been susceptible, and LOSR / LOSS = RR_LOS. A hospital with no resistant admissions in a class is averaged over all its tested admissions instead (fallback_all_admissions = TRUE). The all-hospital values in rr are averaged over every resistant admission.

Confidence intervals

"bootstrap" (default)

Clusters (cluster_id_col, e.g. a patient ID; the admission when NULL) are resampled with replacement within each hospital, the model is refitted, and RR_LOS, LOSR, LOSS and the excess (LOSR - LOSS, computed within each replicate) are recomputed. Intervals are percentiles of the n_boot replicates.

"delta"

Delta method with a cluster-robust (sandwich) covariance matrix. Treats each hospital's admissions as fixed.

"none"

No intervals.

se_log_rr_cluster (the cluster-robust standard error of \(\beta_R\)) is always returned. With return_draws = TRUE the bootstrap replicates are returned so they can be combined with profile draws downstream.
